norm_evaluation_diagnostic.note: Double-precision cancellation on large inherited physical coordinates; this diagnostic is not an exact norm certificate.

scope: Complete numerical plane/edge intersections in one fixed target-H3 Klein chart, from midpoint evaluation of frozen exact171 residual definitions. Actual hyperbolic edges are clipped by every retained halfspace and the unit ball; exterior chart vertices are not hyperbolic vertices. Connected components of the open facet-incidence graph and of the exterior polyhedral skeleton are separate diagnostics, not a proof of ideal-boundary topology. No new exact arithmetic, ambient vertex census, or finite-volume claim.
